values: Domain events between Workbench services, for example on rwb.payment.events.v1

Kafka event topics with 12 partitions, replication factor 3, 7-day retention and record key caseId, the default until RWB-PLT-EVT sets each service. A failed record is retried at 1 min, 10 min and 1 h, then goes to its .dlt topic and raises one alert
Replication and retention of the .dlt dead-letter topics, and partitions and retention of each service's topics until RWB-PLT-EVT sets them (shared topic: GAP-0125)

disposition.note: Event topic policy (retry 1 min, 10 min, 1 h, then .dlt and alert; 12 partitions, RF 3, 7 days default) added to the call-type table; open point recorded in the section 12 table.
